direction_orientation.factual: inherited True minus False; never target-task sign flipped
direction_orientation.physical_token: inherited empirical A-or-1 minus B-or-2 direction
direction_orientation.relation: inherited positive semantic relation minus negative semantic relation; primary vector frozen_dim
direction_orientation.relation_intervention: inherited residual_dim used by original intervention comparison
direction_orientation.sentiment: inherited positive sentiment minus negative sentiment; never target-task sign flipped

final_categories.BROAD_EVALUATIVE_GEOMETRY: factual or sentiment signed AUROC within 0.05 of relation on both tasks with positive orientation and absolute score correlation >= 0.8; Q2 collapses or is weak/inconsistent
final_categories.MIXED_OR_UNDERDETERMINED: any actor/dataset/analysis disagreement or no preceding category passes
final_categories.RELATION_READOUT_STEERING_NONSPECIFIC: Q1 relation stronger than factual/sentiment on both primary tasks by >0.05 signed AUROC margin; Q2 retains; Q3 survives

implementation_binding: final artifact manifest; implementation-only repairs must preserve every frozen rule and be receipted

q1_control_decoding.decode_poorly_rule: signed AUROC interval includes 0.5; intervention evidence is not consulted
q1_control_decoding.row_aggregation: arithmetic mean of frozen condition scores per semantic row

q2_joint_residualization.basis: left singular vectors of normalized nuisance-column matrix
q2_joint_residualization.collapses_rule: both actors: all three corresponding lower bounds fail their positive thresholds
q2_joint_residualization.near_collinear_handling: drop singular values <= tolerance * largest singular value
q2_joint_residualization.retains_rule: both actors: ValuePrism interaction CI low > 0, ValuePrism AUROC CI low > 0.5, AMPERE++ AUROC CI low > 0.5

q3_equal_norm.pairing: exact row IDs, mappings, prompts/base examples; fail on any mismatch
q3_equal_norm.scale_explains_rule: all original lower bounds <= 0 and all equal-norm lower bounds > 0
q3_equal_norm.survives_rule: all actor-dataset factual and sentiment relation-minus-control equal-norm CI lower bounds <= 0

statistics.missing_data: fail on missing required row/condition; standardized quantity unavailable rather than evaluation-fit if selection data absent
